_comment: Synthetic only. The administrator must pin Claude Code >= 2.1.295 to an exact regression-tested build (onFailure: block needs it), replace bare python with its protected executable, and verify package provenance and effective telemetry controls. Hook clients call the running IPv4-loopback gate: start `themis serve` first and provision the gate token once (`themis serve --provision-token`). The server's [hooks] config section is the hook policy and defaults to preparation-only: prompts with personal data are blocked and a de-identified draft is written for you to paste; other prompts are refused; file tools are denied. To let clean prompts and tools through, set [hooks] cloud_authorised = true and list the workspace roots in [hooks] roots, with [gate] synthetic_cloud_authorised = true (see config/rehearsal.example.toml). SessionStart and Stop cannot block; their failures still exit non-zero. MessageDisplay failure leaves canonical placeholder text visible.
